name: desire for meaning
description: Wanting to feel certain and good about your relationship to existence. To do this, we need to feel that we are participating in something clearly important.
perceptions: How I behave matters beyond my own current comfort.
I don't know if I'm on the right track.

guidance.description: What do people value in life? How much of what gives people satisfaction in their lives is fundamental and shared across cultures, and how much is unique to a given society? To understand these and other issues, Pew Research Center posed an open-ended question about the meaning of life to nearly 19,000 adults across 17 advanced economies.
Struggling to find a sense of meaning in life? Researchers have identified three different pathways to it.
guidance.attribution: Joshua A. Hicks, Laura A. King

guidance.description: Other experiences may help dilute and transform feelings of meaningless.

commentaries.quote: Doubt is pain. Existential doubt is existential pain. If we ask ourselves 'Am I doing the right things with my life?' and the answer is fuzzy, it doesn't feel good.

Research corroborates the idea that significance (mattering), coherence (making sense), and purpose (orienting toward goals) represent three interrelated facets of, or perhaps direct pathways to, the experience of meaning in life.
commentaries.attribution: Joshua A. Hicks and Laura A. King

commentaries.quote: Lives may be experienced as meaningful when they are felt to have a significance beyond the trivial or momentary, to have purpose, or to have a coherence that transcends chaos.
commentaries.attribution: King L. A., Hicks J. A., Krull J. L., & Del Gaiso A. K. (2006). Positive affect and the experience of meaning in life.

commentaries.quote: Meaning has to be understood as a relationship rather than an absolute state. We feel meaning when we are connecting us to ourselves, to others, and to the world. We face a meaning crisis when feel anxious & alienated because we’re stuck in our head, lose the sense of embodiment, or feel a weak connection with reality.
Man's main concern is not to take pleasure or avoid pain, but rather to see meaning in his life.

1.description: Self would like to escape the shadow of anxiety cast by doubt.
